thread:
lucy (Sales): FYI Moneta bank asked for a committed capacity proposal for a pilot. They expect 200 QPS baseline, 500 QPS burst up to 20m, avg gen ~180 tokens, context up to 4096. They need p95 < 350ms and explicit billing for bursts.

ryan (Solutions): Got it. Do they plan to use our 13B or prefer a larger model? That will change GPU count.

elena (ML Eng): If they pick a latency-optimized 13B quantized model with batching + KV cache, target perf per A100 ~100-140 tokens/sec effective with aggressive batching. For 180 tokens/request at 200 QPS that's 36k tokens/sec. With batching we can push that onto 4 A100s baseline; p95 target depends on tail behavior.

marc (Infra): Practical mapping: recommend two SKUs to pitch: (A) conservative: 5x reserved A100s baseline with autoscale to 10 for bursts; (B) cost-optimized: 4x reserved with autoscale to 8 and stricter queue-based backpressure. Autoscale triggers: queue_length_seconds > 25 for 45s or avg_gpu_util > 78% for 3m.

lucy (Sales): Nice. Ryan, how do we show unit economics for both options? Customer will want committed discount and headroom pricing.

costbot: Typical committed discounts: 40% for annual reserved, 30% for 6-month. Autoscale hours billed at on-demand rate plus 15% premium.

ryan (Solutions): We'll present two pricing rows and estimated monthly cost ranges including expected autoscale utilization (assume 10% burst usage for plan A, 20% for plan B). Also call out a burst protection cap and notification thresholds.

elena (ML Eng): POC plan: 1) baseline profiling (single GPU) to measure tokens/sec and batching latency, 2) 4x A100 soak at 200 QPS, measure p95 and memory/KV hit, 3) simulate 500 QPS bursts for 20m and validate autoscale to target GPUs and backoff. I can produce locust scripts and a synthetic prompt set.

marc (Infra): For Dedicated we need VPC peering + static egress IPs for Moneta. Security asked about KMS and audit logs. We support AWS KMS and customer-managed keys; audit logs retention is configurable up to 7 years as an add-on.

lucy (Sales): Moneta also requested a short SOC2 note and a template answer for security questionnaire. Tom, can you sign off?

tom (Legal): We'll provide SOC2 attestation and the security questionnaire template. Flag: banking client may require DPA + SCCs. Also need a short clause in SOW that reserves right to throttle unusual traffic patterns during attacks.

ryan (Solutions): Good call. Add a fallback policy: when p95 > 500ms for 3 consecutive 1m windows, route 30% traffic to a smaller quantized model and notify customer. Include canary rollout for model upgrades.

marc (Infra): Suggested autoscale snippet for SOW (example):

```
autoscale: {
  min_reserved_gpus: 5,
  max_gpus: 10,
  scale_up: if queue_seconds > 25 for 45s or avg_gpu_util > 78% for 180s,
  scale_down: if idle_seconds > 300,
  burst_window: 20m
}
```

We will tune thresholds during POC.

elena (ML Eng): Ops estimate for POC: 30 engineer-hours (setup + tuning + analysis) + 8 hours on-call during soak. Add 6 hours for security/legal coordination.

lucy (Sales): Action items: ryan draft pricing + cost assumptions, marc attach security template and autoscale policy, elena prep loadtest scripts and hours, tom prepare DPA checklist. Target POC start in 10 business days.

ryan (Solutions): I'll have a SOW draft and cost worksheet by EOD Wed.

marc (Infra): Provisioning note: staging cluster reserved 5x A100 for 2025-10-05T09:00Z. Will post IP whitelist and maintenance window.

lucy (Sales): Great work team :rocket: We'll present the two-option proposal to Moneta on Friday.
